notes:
Account snapshot and evaluation notes:
- Company: Marigold Catalyst Systems — mid-market B2B productivity platform (workflow automation for ops teams).
- Bought into Redwood hosted API during initial spike; impressed with latency profile and simple SDK. Now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.
- Primary drivers: lower per-token cost for heavy reranking + embeddings workloads, SLOs for <120ms p95 on short chats, EU data residency for a EU-major customer.
- Use-case details: embeddings for semantic search across docs (~80M tokens/month), reranking on top of first-pass retrieval for support & knowledge base (parallelized rerank across 10 candidates), chat assistant for power users (low latency requirement).
- POC plan agreed: 2-week host spike on Redwood hosted to validate prompt/template changes + benchmarks; followed by 4-week Dedicated POC with 2 reserved GPU nodes for production-like workload. SE to provision test harness and cost-metering.
- Cost optimization workshop (requested by Head of Engineering): focus areas: batching configuration per route, prefix/KV caching for frequent prompts, recommended quantization profile(s) for their model family, and unit economics model (cost per 1k queries / per-embedding). Workshop scheduled: 2026-03-09 (internal+Marigold eng + finance). Expected deliverables: batching rules, cache TTL guidance, quantization profile suggestion (int8/4bit tradeoffs), projected monthly cost delta between Hosted vs Dedicated.
- Notes from discovery/demo calls:
  - 2026-02-14 discovery call (ff_20260214_01): Eng team sketched traffic pattern — spikes at 09:00 and 16:00 PST; median seq len ~120 tokens for rerank, embeddings average 768 dims, heavy reuse of recent contexts.
  - 2026-02-21 hosted API spike kickoff: Ran throughput test, p50 latency 65ms, p95 180ms on some routes. Team asked about automatic batching thresholds.
  - 2026-02-28 cost questions: Marigold CFO requested modeled unit economics (hosted vs. 12-mo reserved Dedicated) + sensitivity to quantization. Sent initial draft pricing (drive:/Marigold/Redwood_Pricing_Draft).
- SE observations / recommendations so far:
  - Enable prefix KV caching for support-agent flows — expect 30-40% token reduction on common prompts.
  - Strong candidate for int8 quantization on their preferred model family; recommend a small eval for int4 on non-chat rerank paths.
  - Configure route-level batching: 50ms batching window for rerank route yields >2x throughput improvements with acceptable p95 on their traffic shape.
  - Autoscaling policy: fall back to hosted-compatible model variant for burst traffic; keeps application online during Dedicated maintenance.
- Procurement & legal: security team submitted SOC2 request and KMS integration questionnaire (ticket SEC-893).
- Quote and pricing: requested formal 12-month committed quote for Dedicated (estimate $75-120k ARR depending on commitment level and burst credits).
